es: Volví a medir mi tesis de 2014 sobre entrada y salida de colegios y audité 34 afirmaciones: la historia general resistió, varias cifras no. Auditoría propia, no independiente; nada es causal. Audio: https://open.spotify.com/episode/7ho9naqSgAotsTfcsBmOwc #Educación #DatosAbiertos
en: I measured my 2014 thesis on school entry and exit again and audited 34 claims: the overall story held, several numbers did not. It is my own audit, not an independent replication, and none of it is causal. The Spanish audio capsule is on Spotify. #Education #OpenData
